$comment: Entry schema for contributes.fileTemplates (declarative and process plugins). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_file_templates.go. A file template has exactly one file; a project template has 1 to 64. Target paths are relative POSIX paths (no leading /, no \\, no drive letter, no empty, . or .. segments) of at most 8 segments and 200 bytes, built from [A-Za-z0-9._@+-] and {{mincode.<variable>}} tokens; they may not use .git, .hg, .svn, node_modules or .mincode directories or sensitive filenames such as .env or id_rsa. Sources are .tmpl files under templates/ or assets/ (UTF-8, no NUL, no bidirectional controls); only {{mincode.<variable>}} tokens from the allowlist are replaced and any other {{...}} stays literal. Sources total at most 2 MiB per template. Files are created only after the user reviews a preview, never overwrite existing files and are never executable; there are no hooks or scripts.
description: File and project templates offered by New File from Template and New Project from Template.

kind.description: file: one file created in the chosen folder. project: a new folder with every listed file.

path.description: Target path relative to the chosen folder, for example src/{{mincode.namePascal}}.vue. Variables: name, fileName, projectName, date, year, nameCamel, namePascal, nameKebab, nameSnake.
